column7: Refuses a direct tools/call with no params or no tool name (400, -32602): with no name there is nothing to authorize, so forwarding it would skip the per-tool check (MIK-8361)

The direct route checks before any credential: validates the name, authorizes (a refusal takes the missing name's path, its code kept for the one denied record), runs the request firewall and relay rule, and answers a withheld name as one the catalogue lacks (MIK-8361 ORACLE.2/.4)

Runs authorize, the firewall and the withheld gate before propagate_identity, and answers a no-principal caller on a required per-user backend -32601 before any credential is resolved (MIK-8361 ORACLE.4, C5)

The stdio route stage's authorize over every target: a requested target the caller cannot see takes the missing name's path, a playbook step's target is refused with the neutral step refusal, and the first refusal answers the call (MIK-8361, MIK-8362)

Builds the direct route's answer to a name the caller cannot see (-32601, status preserved), the one answer a withheld and a missing name share; a mistake would let a withheld name answer differently and reveal it exists (MIK-8356, MIK-8361)

Answers a direct call to a name the caller cannot see as a name the catalogue lacks, under no caller's credential, so the gate fills nothing for it and a withheld name answers exactly as a missing one (MIK-8361 ORACLE.2)
Judges whether a gateway_invoke target is one the caller cannot see, before any fill or credential; a mistake would answer a hidden tool by its reason or dispatch it (MIK-8361)
The call-level policy signing runs before the route stage; a mistake would answer a hidden tool's refusal where a missing name meets the kill switch or not-found (MIK-8361 H2/H3)

The invocation policy with existence-dependent capability refusals answered as an undefined capability, for signing and stored task reads; a mistake would let a refusal confirm a capability exists (MIK-8361)
The one predicate for refusals that depend on a capability existing (admin rule, identity grant), read silently; a mistake would map the wrong refusals or confirm a capability exists (MIK-8361)
Answers a defined capability the session's routing profile excludes as an undefined one, writing nothing; a mistake would confirm the capability exists or add an audit record (MIK-8361)
Maps a profile refusal of a defined capability on the invocation policy to the undefined answer and keeps every other refusal; a mistake would hide a kill switch or leak existence (MIK-8361)

Decides at the route stage that every requested target is invisible to the caller, so the call is answered as a missing name before signing and admission act; a mistake would let a hidden name reach them (MIK-8361)
Judges one target's visibility at the route stage and records it for the request; a mistake would answer a hidden and a missing name at different stages (MIK-8361)
The meta layer's withheld gate: a hidden name is answered as a missing one, never dispatched; a mistake would dispatch a hidden tool or answer it by its reason (MIK-8361)
Runs the withheld gate ahead of a dispatch and carries its answer; a mistake would skip the gate on some entry (MIK-8361)

Computes the withheld gate's answer per target kind (capability, per-user, shared backend) before any credential; a mistake would leak a hidden name's existence or resolve a credential for it (MIK-8361)
Refuses at dispatch a target the gate's recorded verdict withheld, whatever the catalogue does after; a mistake would let a refill turn an answered-absent name into a dispatch (MIK-8361)
Answers a name the caller's catalogue withholds or lacks, from the same state for both; a mistake would answer a withheld name from a stale list while a missing one meets the refill (MIK-8361 H1)
Judges a call from the held catalogue without a fill, and defers a withheld name on a stale slot to the refill a missing one meets; a mistake reopens H1 (MIK-8361)
Builds the absent-name answer from the catalogue's completeness, the one text a withheld and a missing name share; a mistake would let the two answers differ (MIK-8361)
